name: Flashyos Tools
description: Flashyos Tools — an instrument on the FlashyOS mesh — a tool that measures the estate and re-reads its source of truth rather than a copy. AAO expands to Agentic Autonomous Organization.

roles.name: maintainer
roles.purpose: Owns the instrument’s correctness and the population it measures, and re-reads the source of truth rather than a copy that can go stale.
roles.measure: Runs producing a reading, as a share of runs

roles.name: review
roles.purpose: Reviews a change to what the tool measures, because a check that goes green for having looked at nothing is this estate’s recorded failure.
roles.measure: Merges carrying a review, as a share of merges

roles.name: release
roles.purpose: Versions and re-vendors the tool into the properties that copy it, keeping every copy byte-identical to canon.
roles.measure: Vendored copies current, as a share of copies

roles.name: conformance
roles.purpose: Runs the tool’s own tests and its vacuity guard, so a traversal that resolves nothing is a red run rather than a clean estate.
roles.measure: Checks passing, as a share of runs

roles.name: operations
roles.purpose: Schedules the tool and reads its output, and keeps a staleness bound against the producer’s cadence rather than when a reader would call the number useless.
roles.measure: Scheduled runs producing a fresh reading, as a share of runs
